confidence_notes: Meal and coffee estimates use nearby 2026 Yogyakarta price data. Beer prices vary by serving and venue; cocktail data is limited, wine is estimated from its local price relationship to beer, and accommodation anchors are holistic estimates rather than live booking prices.
